*See also: [TM1621 LCD Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/tm1621#configuration-variables)*

update_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The interval to re-draw the screen. Defaults to `1s`.

*See also: [TM1621 LCD Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/tm1621#configuration-variables)*

lambda.docs:
**[lambda](https://esphome.io/automations/templates#config-lambda)**: The lambda to use for rendering the content on the TM1621. See [Rendering Lambda](https://esphome.io/components/display/tm1621#display-tm1621_lambda) for more information.

*See also: [TM1621 LCD Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/tm1621#configuration-variables)*
